svg.title: Smart CPU Scheduler — Hackathon Upgrade Architecture
svg.desc: Six upgrade layers from algorithmic depth to UI/UX, showing tasks per layer

g.text: Add Round Robin + Priority Queue; implement preemptive SJF (SRTF); Big-O growth visualiser
Confidence scores on predictions; model explainability; live retraining on user jobs
Comparative analytics: run all algos on same queue; Big-O complexity curve; throughput metrics
Animated Gantt with tick clock; process state machine (ready→running→done); queue visualiser
Benchmark endpoint; CSV bulk import; WebSocket for live queue push; comparison payload
Dark glass sidebar; animated metric cards; smooth Gantt; complexity chart; ML insight panel
